single_outlet_findings.finding: Only outlet to label Times Square 'gun-free' in the headline, converting a crime story into a gun-policy argument absent from every other outlet in the cluster.
Only headline to foreground the attacker's mental health history ('Woman with mental health history charges at NYPD officers'), making it the story's central framing angle rather than the act itself.
Headline 'Woman goes on stabbing spree in Times Square' uses charged language without anti-American amplification — notable restraint given the symbolic value of Times Square.

bottom_line: Headline coverage is near-uniform crime reporting across all ten buckets; the only advertised editorial wedge is Breitbart's gun-free-zone insert in the USA and Times of India's mental-health lead in India.
